wire.binding_rules: Python outer owner/build/worker/source/artifact/selection receipts bind exact suite revision/tree, core revision/tree, method full hash, selected contract/purpose, actual EXE/PDB/tool/lock/source hashes and immutable schedule before launch. case_count_required.handler_calls: uint actual per-case handler increments across BOTH phases; equals handler_delta*(warmup_verified+work_verified). COMMON chooses tag31 iff floor(globaloperation/8)%10==9, otherwise tag0.

wire.errors: First missing/extra I/O, response/header/body/authentication/handler/state/source/layout/budget error fails process and cohort; retain failed stdout/stderr/process receipt and attempted/incomplete/NOTRUN selections. Never emit complete-success JSON for a prefix.
wire.fixture_owner_rules: In measure, latency_backing exactly128000 and calibration_backing65536; qualifier backing may be0 if never allocated or same fixed backing if reserved, but observations/arrays omitted. Array headers separate. Count client Context/RequestRef and declared fixture objects once, no server context/CoreIo/Site already in App. metadata covers counters/route/case bookkeeping; other_explicit covers any further explicit source owners and must be explained by frozen fixture source. static_data is declared fixture static data backing, physical placement/dedup unknown. Compiler initialization/temporaries/futures/peak stack/runtime unknown, excluded from a whole-memory claim.
wire.format: Exactly one UTF-8 JSON object followed by LF on stdout, no other stdout and empty stderr on successful normal CLI; exit0. Unit libtest output separate. Refuse duplicate/unknown keys, wrong JSON types (bool never int), nonfinite/fractional/out-of-range integers. Failure exits nonzero and writes bounded stderr; never emit complete-success JSON for a failed prefix.

wire.state_rules: Every successful response must already have passed exact ACK/MID/8byteToken/code/complete metadata/body/authentication and actual handler-delta checks. Keep saturated dedup history; final dedup need not be empty. No empty final poll or per-operation JSON.
